meeting_summary.title: AI Platform Guild: Taking LLM Agents from Prototype to Production
meeting_summary.note: Fictional sample data for demonstration purposes.

sections.summary: The support-ticket triage agent worked in demos but was unreliable on real traffic, so the team paused the rollout.

topics.title: Demo quality versus production quality
details: Maya explained that the agent was tested on about 40 hand-picked tickets, which hid failure modes seen on real traffic.
Long, multi-issue tickets caused the agent to answer only the first question.
Sofia noted that support leads lost trust after a handful of confidently wrong answers.

sections.summary: The team agreed to build an evaluation harness before adding any new agent capabilities.

topics.title: Building a golden dataset
details: Daniel proposed sampling 300 anonymised historical tickets, stratified by category and length.
Each ticket gets a reference answer reviewed by a senior support agent.
The harness will run on every prompt or model change, like unit tests in CI.

topics.title: LLM-as-judge with guardrails
details: Maya suggested an LLM judge with a fixed rubric, calibrated against human ratings on a subset.
Scores should be computed from rubric items in code rather than asking the model for a single overall number.
A faithfulness check will flag answers that cite policies not present in the knowledge base.

sections.summary: Tracing every agent step turned debugging from guesswork into a routine task.

topics.title: Tracing agent steps
details: Daniel showed traces revealing that most latency came from a retrieval step that was called twice per request.
Removing the duplicate call and caching embeddings cut p95 latency from about 9 seconds to about 4 seconds.
Every trace is tagged with the prompt version so regressions can be tied to a specific change.

sections.summary: The relaunch will keep a human approval step for low-confidence answers.

topics.title: Confidence-based review
details: Answers below the judge's confidence threshold are routed to a support agent for approval or editing.
Reviewer edits are logged and fed back into the golden dataset.
Sofia will track the share of answers approved without edits as the main adoption metric.

sections.summary: The team set a two-week plan to relaunch the agent to a pilot group.

topics.title: Action items
details: Daniel builds the golden dataset and CI evaluation job.
Maya implements the rubric-based judge and faithfulness check.
Sofia recruits five support leads for the pilot and defines success criteria.
